features: Opt-in time-window Hampel bounded short-island repair and separate median smoothing
Sustained crossing qualification, fixed-band time occupancy and maximum excursions
Unfiltered raw hard-limit veto and raw/processed peak-conflict review
Asymmetric digital dwell with suppression audit and chatter budgets
Full-window processed trace hashing; raw/processed/candidate overlays with interactive time zoom

tests.seeded_holdout_note: 64 disjoint seeds x 3 synthetic families, included in standard library total; not a field accuracy estimate
tests.counting_note: Verification layers overlap and must not be summed as independent tests. All expected statuses/metric ranges are predeclared.

documentation.guide: docs/ESS_WaveTest_v1.2_抗噪算法与复杂波形验证.pdf
documentation.historical_manuals: v1.0 PDF/DOCX and v1.1 PDF/HTML retained and labelled historical

limits: No actual customer/vendor field recording calibration or site acceptance.
Windows and macOS startup scripts supplied but not natively executed.
Managed browser blocks direct localhost navigation; UI tests use a Python transport bridge to the real loopback HTTP server. Packaged HTTP tested separately. OS-level downloads not verified.
All threshold examples are synthetic engineering choices, not an approved standards library.
Robust analog mode is offline centered and opt-in; it changes explicitly documented measurement definitions. Review guards are not metrological confidence intervals.
Candidate spikes/suppressed pulses are not proven measurement artifacts; preserve raw protective assertions and calibrate policy before acceptance.
Legacy segment endpoint interpolation may use bracketing native samples; no gap filling. Trigger/digital qualification uses strict end-of-window native samples.
Only supported CFG/DAT subset, not formal COMTRADE conformance. No CFF, GOOSE/SV validation, online controls, full harmonic/sequence/power reconstruction.
New robust fields edited through JSON, no complete graphical noise-parameter wizard.
No v1.2 coverage percent or field false-positive/false-negative rate claimed. Historical 93% belongs only to v1.0.
